backend/main.mo: Motoko backend managing user profiles, roles, and access control with admin checks, signup, profile updates, and full system reset functions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence listing frontend files, components, and test IDs tied to session handling and signup debugging improvements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file including hooks, pages, components, and utilities.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment runbook explaining normal vs fresh deployments, admin reset steps, reinstall procedures, and post-deploy checks.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining color tokens and theme variables for light and dark mode using OKLCH values.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app router and auth flow controller handling identity, profile loading, error detection, and conditional rendering for login, setup, and session invalid states.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: UI component displaying an admin-only access restriction message with a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Header component showing logo, navigation links, and logout based on authentication and admin status.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Main application layout wrapping pages with header, footer, and centered content area.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Login and signup screen using Internet Identity with handling for stale sessions and switch-account option.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Signup form collecting user details, validating input, and submitting profile creation with role selection.
frontend/src/components/SessionInvalidSc: Screen shown when a session is invalid, prompting users to fully log out and sign in again.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on identity, reinitializing and invalidating queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFullLogout.ts: Provides a complete logout routine clearing identity, app data, session storage, and reloading the page.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login state, loading identities, and interacting with AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, admin checks, user management, and service report data via a backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light and dark themes using an industrial color palette.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, setting up the QueryClient and Internet Identity provider before rendering the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Renders the admin user management interface with user listing, deletion, purge/reset actions, and admin access enforcement.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a single service report, handling loading, error states, and navigation back to history.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Implements the form for creating a new service report with validation, field state, and submission via a createReport mutation.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: Shows a searchable and filterable list of past service reports, with navigation to create new entries and report detail views.
frontend/src/utils/authErrorDetection.ts: Provides helpers to identify missing-profile versus real authentication errors by matching message patterns.
frontend/src/utils/authSessionCleanup.ts: Clears auth-related keys from localStorage and sessionStorage to fully reset Internet Identity session data.
Maps backend signup error messages to short user-friendly strings with a safe fallback.
frontend/src/utils/signupFlowDebug.ts: Sanitizes and logs signup/profile-flow data while redacting sensitive fields and patterns.
frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Validates required fields, email format, and mobile number formatting for signup inputs.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme extensions, colors, animations, plugins, and content paths.
project_state.json: Defines current project status, issues, features, and pending requests for the signup-flow fix work.
